text:
payments-bot: Automated dunning notice sent to VerdantAI (INV-2026-0043). Email bounced and card declined x3. Outstanding balance $28,940. Final notice sent 2026-03-28. Next recommended step? :warning:

Tara (Finance): Can someone confirm our cutoff thresholds for suspending dedicated capacity vs soft reminders? I don't want to trigger an outage without signoff.

Jordan (Collections): I can try a last outreach call + offer a 3-installment plan (no fee). Historically that saves churn. Will need AE buy-in for backup card pre-auth.

Carlos (Account Executive): Customer is strategic — they said procurement was reviewing. AE notes: finance team is out until mid-April, asked for time. We should be cautious about immediate full suspension.

Maya (Legal): If we pursue suspension/termination we need to reference the contract: clause 4.2 covers non-payment remedies and notice windows. Send me the invoice and timeline, I'll confirm legal posture.

Sophie (Customer Success): I was on a call last week. VerdantAI committed to escalate internally but asked for a short extension until EOM. They specifically requested a written payment plan.

Tara (Finance): Proposed approach: offer a 30-day extension + optional 3-month installment plan starting day 31. Require signed payment agreement and backup card pre-authorization. If they miss 1 payment, suspend dedicated GPU pools (keep hosted API live for critical endpoints) and escalate to legal. Approve?

Carlos (Account Executive): +1 to the plan. I'll push the AE to get the backup card and signed agreement this week. Need CSM to coordinate messaging.

Jordan (Collections): I'll draft the payment agreement and payment link. Sending tonight. @Maya — please review the agreement language for enforceability.

Maya (Legal): Reviewed clause 4.2; the suspension timeline above is consistent with contract terms. I want the signed agreement before we do any suspension.

ops-bot: ACTION ITEM logged: create suspension runbook ticket if no signed agreement by 2026-04-30. Ticket #SR-8842.

Tara (Finance): Filing the runbook ticket now and assigning to Eng-Platform for hold. Also flagging Dedicated capacity owner so we don't disrupt any legal-critical jobs.

payments-bot: Logged dunning status=final; outreach=phone+email; next_action=await_signed_agreement_or_hold

Sophie (Customer Success): I'll set up a joint call with VerdantAI and AE tomorrow to get them to sign. Will post update in this thread after the call. :+1:

Tara (Finance): Thanks everyone. If we get a signed agreement, route payment to clearing and close the dunning flow. If not, follow the runbook on 04-30.
